citation: Rosner P., Dietermann B., Brödel M., Paper A., Lienkamp M. (2025). REVOL-E-TION: A Flexible and Scalable Investment Optimization Toolbox for Local Energy Systems Incorporating Electric Vehicle Fleets. SoftwareX. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.softx.2025.102178
description: REVOL-E-TION optimises electric-vehicle fleets within local energy systems and estimates costs and revenues. It wraps oemof and includes fleet, battery and mobility-related submodels. The provider is Technical University of Munich. Coverage: The software is generic, not a measured geographic dataset. Spatial detail and simulation periods are supplied by the user. Access: The public source repository provides documentation and installation instructions. Source archives and dependencies were not downloaded or run. Licence and cost: The README explicitly identifies Apache 2.0. Solver and input-data conditions are separate. Limitations: The repository documents several publications and contributions through 2026. Economic results remain conditional on user inputs and model assumptions; no run was tested. For simulation it supports EV-fleet integration and local energy-management comparisons. Related resources: The toolbox builds on the oemof family, represented by model-oemof-solph.
